<thought>Using the ESI‑MS data, the most intense ion is at m/z 224.1201, which corresponds to the protonated molecule [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 223.1128 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈ 17 % M+1) indicates roughly 15 carbon atoms. A formula that fits this mass and the observed isotopic pattern is C₁₅H₁₃NO (monoisotopic mass 223.0997 Da, within experimental error). Therefore the molecular formula of the sample compound is C15H13NO. </thought>
<final_answer>C15H13NO</final_answer>
